verses.original: מִשְׁלֵ֗י שְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה פ בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־ אָ֑ב וּבֵ֥ן כְּ֝סִ֗יל תּוּגַ֥ת אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: miš·lê šə·lō·mōh p̄ bên ḥā·ḵām yə·śam·maḥ- ’āḇ ū·ḇên kə·sîl tū·ḡaṯ ’im·mōw
verses.literal: The proverbs of Solomon A wise son brings joy to his father but a foolish son grief to his mother

verses.original: לֹא־ י֭וֹעִילוּ אוֹצְר֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yō·w·‘î·lū ’ō·wṣ·rō·wṯ re·ša‘ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh taṣ·ṣîl mim·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing but righteousness brings deliverance from death

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יַרְעִ֣יב יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְהַוַּ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים יֶהְדֹּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yar·‘îḇ Yah·weh ne·p̄eš ṣad·dîq wə·haw·waṯ rə·šā·‘îm yeh·dōp̄
verses.literal: The LORD . . . does not let the righteous go hungry but He denies the craving of the wicked

verses.original: רָ֗אשׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה כַף־ רְמִיָּ֑ה וְיַ֖ד חָרוּצִ֣ים תַּעֲשִֽׁיר׃
verses.transliteration: rāš ‘ō·śeh ḵap̄- rə·mî·yāh wə·yaḏ ḥā·rū·ṣîm ta·‘ă·šîr
verses.literal: Idle hands make one poor but diligent hands bring wealth

verses.original: אֹגֵ֣ר בַּ֭קַּיִץ בֵּ֣ן מַשְׂכִּ֑יל נִרְדָּ֥ם בַּ֝קָּצִ֗יר בֵּ֣ן מֵבִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·ḡêr baq·qa·yiṣ bên maś·kîl nir·dām baq·qā·ṣîr bên mê·ḇîš
verses.literal: He who gathers in summer is a wise son but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son

verses.original: בְּ֭רָכוֹת לְרֹ֣אשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rā·ḵō·wṯ lə·rōš ṣad·dîq ū·p̄î rə·šā·‘îm yə·ḵas·seh ḥā·mās
verses.literal: Blessings are on the head of the righteous but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence

verses.original: זֵ֣כֶר צַ֭דִּיק לִבְרָכָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֖ם רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְקָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: zê·ḵer ṣad·dîq liḇ·rā·ḵāh wə·šêm rə·šā·‘îm yir·qāḇ
verses.literal: The memory of the righteous is a blessing but the name of the wicked will rot

verses.original: חֲכַם־ לֵ֭ב יִקַּ֣ח מִצְוֺ֑ת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḵam- lêḇ yiq·qaḥ miṣ·wōṯ we·’ĕ·wîl śə·p̲ā·t̲a·yim yil·lā·ḇêṭ
verses.literal: A wise heart will receive commandments but foolish lips will come to ruin

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בַּ֭תֹּם יֵ֣לֶךְ בֶּ֑טַח וּמְעַקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו יִוָּדֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·lêḵ bat·tōm yê·leḵ be·ṭaḥ ū·mə·‘aq·qêš də·rā·ḵāw yiw·wā·ḏê·a‘
verses.literal: He who walks in integrity walks securely but he who perverts his ways will be found out

verses.original: קֹ֣רֵֽץ עַ֭יִן יִתֵּ֣ן עַצָּ֑בֶת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃
verses.transliteration: qō·rēṣ ‘a·yin yit·tên ‘aṣ·ṣā·ḇeṯ we·’ĕ·wîl śə·p̲ā·t̲a·yim yil·lā·ḇêṭ
verses.literal: He who winks the eye causes grief and foolish lips will come to ruin

verses.original: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים פִּ֣י צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: mə·qō·wr ḥay·yîm pî ṣad·dîq ū·p̄î rə·šā·‘îm yə·ḵas·seh ḥā·mās
verses.literal: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence

verses.original: שִׂ֭נְאָה תְּעוֹרֵ֣ר מְדָנִ֑ים וְעַ֥ל כָּל־ פְּ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תְּכַסֶּ֥ה אַהֲבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: śin·ʾāh tə·‘ō·w·rêr mə·ḏā·nîm wə·‘al kāl- pə·šā·‘îm tə·ḵas·seh ’a·hă·ḇāh
verses.literal: Hatred stirs up dissension . . . but love covers all transgressions

verses.original: בְּשִׂפְתֵ֣י נָ֭בוֹן תִּמָּצֵ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו חֲסַר־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·śip̄·ṯê nā·ḇō·wn tim·mā·ṣê ḥāḵ·māh wə·šê·ḇeṭ lə·ḡêw ḥă·sar- lêḇ
verses.literal: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment

verses.original: חֲכָמִ֥ים יִצְפְּנוּ־ דָ֑עַת וּפִֽי־ אֱ֝וִיל מְחִתָּ֥ה קְרֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḵā·mîm yiṣ·pə·nū- ḏā·‘aṯ ū·p̄î- ’ĕ·wîl mə·ḥit·tāh qə·rō·ḇāh
verses.literal: The wise store up knowledge but the mouth of the fool invites destruction

verses.original: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ מְחִתַּ֖ת דַּלִּ֣ים רֵישָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: hō·wn ‘ā·šîr qir·yaṯ ‘uz·zōw mə·ḥit·taṯ dal·lîm rê·šām
verses.literal: The wealth of the rich man is his fortified city but poverty is the ruin of the poor

verses.original: פְּעֻלַּ֣ת צַדִּ֣יק לְחַיִּ֑ים תְּבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: pə·‘ul·laṯ ṣad·dîq lə·ḥay·yîm tə·ḇū·’aṯ rā·šā‘ lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: The labor of the righteous leads to life but the gain of the wicked brings punishment

verses.original: אֹ֣רַח לְ֭חַיִּים שׁוֹמֵ֣ר מוּסָ֑ר וְעוֹזֵ֖ב תּוֹכַ֣חַת מַתְעֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·raḥ lə·ḥay·yîm šō·w·mêr mū·sār wə·‘ō·w·zêḇ tō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ maṯ·‘eh
verses.literal: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life but he who ignores reproof goes astray

verses.original: מְכַסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה שִׂפְתֵי־ שָׁ֑קֶר וּמוֹצִ֥א דִ֝בָּ֗ה ה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ḵas·seh śin·ʾāh śip̄·ṯê- šā·qer ū·mō·w·ṣi ḏib·bāh hū ḵə·sîl
verses.literal: The one who conceals hatred has lying lips and whoever spreads slander . . . is a fool

verses.original: בְּרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֶחְדַּל־ פָּ֑שַׁע וְחֹשֵׂ֖ךְ שְׂפָתָ֣יו מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rōḇ də·ḇā·rîm lō yeḥ·dal- pā·ša‘ wə·ḥō·śêḵ śə·p̄ā·ṯāw maś·kîl
verses.literal: When words are many sin is unavoidable . . . but he who restrains his lips is wise

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף נִ֭בְחָר לְשׁ֣וֹן צַדִּ֑יק לֵ֖ב רְשָׁעִ֣ים כִּמְעָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ke·sep̄ niḇ·ḥār lə·šō·wn ṣad·dîq lêḇ rə·šā·‘îm kim·‘āṭ
verses.literal: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver but the heart of the wicked has little worth

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יִרְע֣וּ רַבִּ֑ים וֶֽ֝אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּחֲסַר־ לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: śip̄·ṯê ṣad·dîq yir·‘ū rab·bîm we·’ĕ·wî·lîm ba·ḥă·sar- lêḇ yā·mū·ṯū
verses.literal: The lips of the righteous feed many but fools die for lack of judgment

verses.original: בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הִ֣יא תַעֲשִׁ֑יר וְלֹֽא־ יוֹסִ֖ף עֶ֣צֶב עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bir·kaṯ Yah·weh hî ṯa·‘ă·šîr wə·lō- yō·w·sip̄ ‘e·ṣeḇ ‘im·māh
verses.literal: The blessing of the LORD . . . enriches and He adds no sorrow to it

verses.original: כִּשְׂח֣וֹק לִ֭כְסִיל עֲשׂ֣וֹת זִמָּ֑ה וְ֝חָכְמָ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kiś·ḥō·wq liḵ·sîl ‘ă·śō·wṯ zim·māh wə·ḥā·ḵə·māh lə·’îš tə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: The fool delights in shameful conduct but a man of understanding has wisdom

verses.original: מְגוֹרַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע הִ֣יא תְבוֹאֶ֑נּוּ וְתַאֲוַ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ḡō·w·raṯ rā·šā‘ hî ṯə·ḇō·w·’en·nū wə·ṯa·’ă·waṯ ṣad·dî·qîm yit·tên
verses.literal: What the wicked man . . . dreads will overtake him but the desire of the righteous will be granted

verses.original: כַּעֲב֣וֹר ס֭וּפָה וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ka·‘ă·ḇō·wr sū·p̄āh wə·’ên rā·šā‘ wə·ṣad·dîq yə·sō·wḏ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: When the whirlwind passes the wicked are no more but the righteous are secure forever

verses.original: כַּחֹ֤מֶץ׀ לַשִּׁנַּ֗יִם וְכֶעָשָׁ֥ן לָעֵינָ֑יִם כֵּ֥ן הֶ֝עָצֵ֗ל לְשֹׁלְחָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ka·ḥō·meṣ laš·šin·na·yim wə·ḵe·‘ā·šān lā·‘ê·nā·yim kên he·‘ā·ṣêl lə·šō·lə·ḥāw
verses.literal: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes so is the slacker to those who send him

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה תּוֹסִ֣יף יָמִ֑ים וּשְׁנ֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּקְצֹֽרְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh tō·w·sîp̄ yā·mîm ū·šə·nō·wṯ rə·šā·‘îm tiq·ṣō·rə·nāh
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD prolongs life but the years of the wicked will be cut short

verses.original: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת צַדִּיקִ֣ים שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְתִקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·ḥe·leṯ ṣad·dî·qîm śim·ḥāh wə·ṯiq·waṯ rə·šā·‘îm tō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: The hope of the righteous is joy but the expectations of the wicked will perish

verses.original: מָע֣וֹז לַ֭תֹּם דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: mā·‘ō·wz lat·tōm de·reḵ Yah·weh ū·mə·ḥit·tāh lə·p̄ō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: The way of the LORD is a refuge to the upright but destruction awaits those who do evil

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק לְעוֹלָ֣ם בַּל־ יִמּ֑וֹט וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִשְׁכְּנוּ־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq lə·‘ō·w·lām bal- yim·mō·wṭ ū·rə·šā·‘îm lō yiš·kə·nū- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The righteous will never . . . be shaken but the wicked will not inhabit the land

verses.original: פִּֽי־ צַ֭דִּיק יָנ֣וּב חָכְמָ֑ה וּלְשׁ֥וֹן תַּ֝הְפֻּכ֗וֹת תִּכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: pî- ṣad·dîq yā·nūḇ ḥāḵ·māh ū·lə·šō·wn tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ tik·kā·rêṯ
verses.literal: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom but a perverse tongue will be cut out

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יֵדְע֣וּן רָצ֑וֹן וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: śip̄·ṯê ṣad·dîq yê·ḏə·‘ūn rā·ṣō·wn ū·p̄î rə·šā·‘îm tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ
verses.literal: The lips of the righteous know what is fitting but the mouth of the wicked is perverse
